name: Clarinet
author: Versilian Studios (samples); DAW build script
attribution: Versilian Studios VSCO-2 Community Edition (Sam Gossner / Versilian Studios), CC0 1.0
desc: Bb clarinet, sustained, 2 dynamics. Warm woody low (chalumeau), clear bright top. Range D3-G6. Lyrical melodies, jazzy lines, soft inner harmonies. | Playable MIDI 50-91 (D3-G6), 2 velocity layers crossfaded. Params: human 0-1 (timing/level/pitch life), velcurve (velocity response), keytrack/bright (tone follows pitch/velocity). Legato melody: overlap consecutive notes by ~30 ms (next note starts before the previous ends) with glide 0.03-0.06; wide leaps crossfade naturally (legato=1), legato=0 = pure slide.
